rationale: C15 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. Both orders first declare a policy concerning the welfare or treatment of persons in the armed forces, then establish a presidential committee, specify its membership, empower it to examine or appraise existing practices, direct it to confer with the same defense leadership and recommend measures to the President and those Secretaries, and require federal agencies to cooperate and furnish information. The close language and matching operative sequence substantially exceed generic committee boilerplate. C08 and C02 share portions of the committee-establishment machinery but lack C15's unusually close armed-forces policy and duties structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is hereby declared to be the policy of the Government to encourage and promote the religious, moral, and recreational welfare and character guidance of persons in the armed forces
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is hereby declared to be the policy of the President that there shall be equality of treatment and opportunity for all persons in the armed services
shared_material.explanation: Both open their operative provisions with a declared presidential policy directed at the treatment or welfare of persons serving in the armed forces.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the President's Committee on Religious and Moral Welfare and Character Guidance in the Armed Forces
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There shall be created in the national Military Establishment an advisory committee to be known as the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services
shared_material.explanation: Both create similarly named President's Committees devoted to implementing the preceding armed-services policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: confer and advise with the Secretary of Defense and the Secretaries of the Army, Navy, and Air Force ... and make such recommendations to the President and the said Secretaries as it shall deem appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: confer and advise with the Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of the Army, the Secretary of the Navy, and the Secretary of the Air Force, and shall make such recommendations to the President and to said Secretaries as in the judgment of the Committee will effectuate the policy hereof
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly parallel language assigning consultation with the identical defense officials and recommendations to the same recipients for effectuating the policy.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Agencies of the Government are requested to cooperate with the Committee and to furnish it such available information as it may require for the performance of its duties.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work, and to furnish the Committee such information ... as the Committee may require in the performance of its duties.
shared_material.explanation: The cooperation-and-information provision is materially similar in language and placement within the shared committee framework.
